caption:
Half a degree. The sunflower fills up.

Turn each new seed 137.00° from the last and the worst ring scores 0.563.

Turn it to 137.51°, the golden angle. The worst ring jumps to 0.884.

Near the rim: 34 spirals one way, 55 the other. The plant never counts. One angle does it.
